name: test_fill_basic/basic_open
note: Control constants from gatchat/gsm0710.h: SABM|PF=0x3F, DISC|PF=0x53, UIH|PF=0xEF. Address 0x07 = DLCI 1, C/R=1, EA=1. Basic option: F9 flags, length octet with EA (2-octet length when >127: here 136 bytes -> 10 01), FCS over address+control+length. fcs value = the octet before the closing flag as listed.

name: test_extract_basic/basic_input
note: gsm0710_basic_extract_frame on 4 garbage bytes + two frames sharing one flag. Call 1 nread not asserted (test relies on it skipping the 4 garbage bytes). Partial frame (no closing flag) -> nread 0. nread consumes open flag + frame but leaves the closing flag (it can open the next frame). dlc/ctrl outputs NOT asserted. call slices: FFFFFFFF; F907EF07123456D3; F907EF07123456D3F9; F907EF07123456D3F9; F9

name: test_extract_basic/basic_input2
note: Two frames separated by back-to-back flags F9 F9. Second call nread not asserted individually; total consumed == len-1.

name: test_extract_advanced/advanced_input
note: Advanced-option equivalent of extract_basic (3 garbage bytes, two frames sharing a flag). dlc/ctrl NOT asserted.

name: test_extract_advanced/advanced_input2
note: Note: advanced_input2 is byte-identical to advanced_input in the source (unlike basic_input2 it has no double flag).

name: test_modem_cmux_receive_dlci2_ppp
note: Zephyr modem_cmux as initiator (TE), basic option, CONFIG_MODEM_CMUX_MTU=64, MSC_FC_THRESHOLD=64, DLCI rx buffers 127 bytes. 70 bytes into a 127-byte buffer above the 64-byte threshold => CMUX sends MSC with FC set (mock transaction).

name: test_modem_cmux_flow_control_dlci2
note: Zephyr modem_cmux as initiator (TE), basic option, CONFIG_MODEM_CMUX_MTU=64, MSC_FC_THRESHOLD=64, DLCI rx buffers 127 bytes. FCoff blocks transmit (returns 0 bytes, nothing on the wire); FCon re-enables. Encoder vector: 52-byte payload on DLCI2 => exact UIH frame cmux_frame_dlci2_ppp_52.

name: test_modem_cmux_resync
note: Zephyr modem_cmux as initiator (TE), basic option, CONFIG_MODEM_CMUX_MTU=64, MSC_FC_THRESHOLD=64, DLCI rx buffers 127 bytes. Leading garbage tail of a frame (41 54 30 F9) is discarded; decoder resyncs on flags.

name: test_modem_drop_frames_with_invalid_length
note: Zephyr modem_cmux as initiator (TE), basic option, CONFIG_MODEM_CMUX_MTU=64, MSC_FC_THRESHOLD=64, DLCI rx buffers 127 bytes. Length octet 0xFE (EA=0 => 2-byte length, larger than buffer) => frame dropped; following valid frames decoded.

name: test_modem_cmux_chain_send
note: Zephyr modem_cmux as initiator (TE), basic option, CONFIG_MODEM_CMUX_MTU=64, MSC_FC_THRESHOLD=64, DLCI rx buffers 127 bytes. Scatter-gather transmit goes out as one UIH frame (5 + 6).
